audience: Grade 5-6 / ages 10-12; English, Filipino and Taglish
basis: Owner-accepted project policy pending educator/ethics review before real-child use.
scope: Assess meaning and visible evidence in context, not keywords, genre, species or language alone. Assess threatening or encouraging visual framing independently of a cautionary caption.
guidance: An automated label is evidence, not a category veto. Allow means the exact subject does not cross the prohibited boundary. For a broad or unknown label, review the full checklist. Privacy failures, service errors, missing pictures and provider refusals cannot be cleared. If uncertain, leave the story held. Replacement and stop are separate decisions.
theme_scope: Optional classroom themes default off and apply only to submitted story text. They are separate from shared safety and are not detected again per picture.

criteria.name: Sexual content
criteria.trigger: Sexual acts, erotic detail, sexualized pose/focus, sexual coercion or exploitation, including fictional/animal characters
criteria.exception: Ordinary affection and age-appropriate non-erotic factual body discussion; never an exemption for prohibited exposure

criteria.name: Exposure
criteria.trigger: Visible genitals, clearly exposed buttocks or bare breasts in generated images
criteria.exception: Ordinary swimwear, covered caregiving and changing behind a screen, with no sexualization

criteria.name: Graphic harm
criteria.trigger: Gore, visible organs, dismemberment, graphic wounds or prolonged graphic suffering, including animals
criteria.exception: Non-graphic conflict/injury, danger, loss and rescue without graphic detail

criteria.name: Harm instruction
criteria.trigger: Actionable steps, encouragement or celebratory framing inviting imitation of violence, self-harm, dangerous challenges, weapon-making or abuse
criteria.exception: Non-actionable, non-graphic narrative depiction, prevention, seeking help and recovery

criteria.name: Targeted abuse
criteria.trigger: Encouraged bullying, credible threats, dehumanization or violence toward a person/group, including discriminatory attacks
criteria.exception: Clearly critical non-graphic depiction, standing up to bullying, reconciliation and indirect narration of prejudice

criteria.name: Discriminatory slur
criteria.trigger: Explicit discriminatory slurs in material cleared for generation/display, including critical quotation
criteria.exception: Indirect narration without reproducing the slur; revised wording is a new child submission

criteria.name: Exploitation
criteria.trigger: Encouraging grooming, coercion, sexual exploitation, trafficking or abuse of a child/person/animal; instructions facilitating it
criteria.exception: Non-graphic prevention/help-seeking or a critical reference without exploitative detail

criteria.name: Substances
criteria.trigger: Instructions encouraging a child to obtain, prepare, misuse or conceal intoxicants, drugs or poisons
criteria.exception: Non-graphic critical depiction, refusal, prevention or recovery without instructions/encouragement

criteria.name: Adult detail
criteria.trigger: Explicit non-discriminatory sexual/abusive language or non-educational adult sexual detail intended for child presentation
criteria.exception: Ordinary disagreement, mild exclamations, factual non-erotic discussion and emotional expression

criteria.name: Privacy
criteria.trigger: Structured personal identifiers not successfully redacted, contact solicitation or exposing someone's private information
criteria.exception: Successfully privacy-processed fictional narrative; cannot override a failed privacy process

optional_themes.name: Spooky suspense
optional_themes.trigger: Narrative fear, threatening suspense, frightening supernatural encounters or deliberately spooky settings
optional_themes.exception: Friendly magic/creatures or darkness with no fear/threat/suspense

optional_themes.name: Story conflict
optional_themes.trigger: Physical fighting, hostile arguments or bullying between story characters, without requiring graphic harm
optional_themes.exception: Friendly competition, respectful disagreement or merely describing a past resolved disagreement

optional_themes.name: Loss separation
optional_themes.trigger: Narrative sadness about death/loss, grief, abandonment or separation from an important person/animal
optional_themes.exception: Brief disappointment or a routine goodbye with no sadness/loss/separation theme
